pages.text: Behind the chapel altar sits a sealed gate. A $(item)Crest of Artorias$() opens it for everyone, for good: 8 Ruin Fragments and a Soul of Undead, found in old dungeons.$(br2)Lordran holds the Asylum, the Undead Parish and Burg, Sen's Fortress, the Catacombs and Artorias' Colosseum, and their demons.
$(l)Right-click your bed before you go$(), or the Homeward Bone sends you somewhere unpleasant.
